description: Structured eval definitions for the Lex Bot Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Lex V2 bot topologies (coffee ordering bot with dialog + fulfillment code hooks and slot priorities, voice bot with Polly neural and sentiment analysis, multi-intent bot with version and alias blue-green, custom slot types with confirmation and closing prompts, missing Lambda resource-based permission prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Coffee ordering bot with dialog and fulfillment code hooks
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — full bot with custom slot types, explicit slot priorities, both DIALOG_CODE_HOOK and FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK wired, conversation logs, KMS encryption, version and alias
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lex V2 bot named OrderCoffeeBot in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Locale en-US, NLU confidence threshold 0.40. Intents: OrderCoffee, Greeting, Fallback. OrderCoffee has slots CoffeeSize (required, priority 1, custom slot type CoffeeSizeType), CoffeeDrink (required, priority 2, custom slot type CoffeeDrinkType), and CoffeeTemp (optional, priority 3, AMAZON.AlphaNumeric). Wire both DIALOG_CODE_HOOK and FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK to Lambda function OrderCoffeeFulfillment. Enable conversation logs (text only) to CloudWatch Logs group /aws/lex/OrderCoffeeBot. KMS CMK abc-def-123 for encryption. Build the locale, create bot version 1, and alias prod pointing at version 1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LEX_BOT: OrderCoffeeBot (bot-abc123) | locale: en-US | alias: prod → 1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bot: OrderCoffeeBot (bot-abc123), dataPrivacy childDirected=false
  [✓] Locale: en-US — Built (NLU threshold 0.40)
  [✓] Slots (priority order): CoffeeSize:CoffeeSizeType:required (priority 1), CoffeeDrink:CoffeeDrinkType:required (priority 2), CoffeeTemp:AMAZON.AlphaNumeric:optional (priority 3)
  [✓] Code hook: DIALOG_CODE_HOOK=enabled, FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK=enabled
  [✓] Lambda resource-based permission: lexv2.amazonaws.com granted
  [✓] Conversation logs: text=on
  [✓] KMS encryption: abc-def-123
  [✓] Bot version: 1, Alias: prod → 1

eval_cases.name: Voice bot with Polly neural voice, sentiment analysis, and Twilio channel
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — voice bot with Polly neural Joanna, sentiment analysis enabled, Twilio SMS channel integration with Secrets Manager credentials
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lex V2 voice bot named CustomerSupportBot in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Locale en-US, Polly neural voice_id Joanna. Enable sentiment analysis. Intent: HandleComplaint with slots IssueType (required, priority 1, AMAZON.AlphaNumeric) and Severity (required, priority 2, AMAZON.Number). Wire DIALOG_CODE_HOOK and FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK to Lambda ComplaintHandler. Build, version 1, alias prod. Integrate Twilio SMS channel (credentials in Secrets Manager twilio/customersupport).
eval_cases.expected_output:
LEX_BOT: CustomerSupportBot (bot-def456) | locale: en-US | alias: prod → 1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Voice: Polly voice_id=Joanna, engine=neural
  [✓] Sentiment analysis: enabled
  [✓] Channel integration: Twilio (Secrets Manager: twilio/customersupport)

eval_cases.name: Multi-intent bot with blue-green version and alias deployment
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-intent bot with ReturnIntent fulfillment, two bot versions, prod and staging aliases for blue-green
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lex V2 bot named MultiIntentBot in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Locale en-US. Intents: BookFlight, CancelFlight, CheckStatus, Greeting, Fallback. Each intent has required slots with explicit priorities. Wire DIALOG_CODE_HOOK only (no fulfillment — client handles action via ReturnIntent). Build the locale, create bot version 1 and version 2, create alias prod pointing at version 1 and alias staging pointing at version 2 for blue-green deployment.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LEX_BOT: MultiIntentBot (bot-ghi789) | locale: en-US | alias: prod → 1, staging → 2
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Fulfillment mode: ReturnIntent
  [✓] Bot version: 1 and 2
  [✓] Alias: prod → 1, staging → 2 (blue-green)

eval_cases.name: Custom slot types with confirmation, closing, and failure prompts
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom slot type enumerations (PizzaSize, PizzaCrust), confirmation/closing/failure prompts, both code hooks wired
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lex V2 bot named PizzaOrderBot in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Locale en-US. Intent: OrderPizza with custom slot types PizzaSize (values: small, medium, large) and PizzaCrust (values: thin, thick, stuffed). Slots: PizzaSize (required, priority 1), PizzaCrust (required, priority 2), Quantity (optional, priority 3, AMAZON.Number). Configure confirmation prompt "Should I order a {Quantity} {PizzaSize} {PizzaCrust} pizza?", closing prompt "Your pizza order is confirmed.", and failure prompt "Okay, I've cancelled that." Wire DIALOG_CODE_HOOK and FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK to Lambda PizzaOrderFulfillment. Build, version 1, alias prod.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LEX_BOT: PizzaOrderBot (bot-jkl012) | locale: en-US | alias: prod → 1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Custom slot types: PizzaSize (small/medium/large), PizzaCrust (thin/thick/stuffed)
  [✓] Prompts: elicitation, confirmation, closing, failure
  [✓] Code hook: DIALOG_CODE_HOOK=enabled, FULFILLMENT_CODE_HOOK=enabled

eval_cases.name: Lambda code hook without resource-based permission (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Lambda function lacks resource-based permission granting lexv2.amazonaws.com invoke access; code hook will silently fail at runtime
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Lex V2 bot named BrokenHookBot in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Locale en-US. Intent: TestIntent with slot TestSlot (required, priority 1, AMAZON.AlphaNumeric). Wire DIALOG_CODE_HOOK to Lambda function OrderCoffeeFulfillment. The Lambda does NOT have a resource-based permission granting lexv2.amazonaws.com invoke access. Build, version 1, alias prod.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LEX_BOT: BrokenHookBot
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Lambda resource-based permission: MISSING — lexv2.amazonaws.com not granted on OrderCoffeeFulfillment; code hook will silently fail at runtime
